name: Agents' Last Exam (ALE-V1)
protocol: Source export protocol; row-level protocol details are preserved when available.

explanation.en: Pass rate is the share of task runs that earn a perfect score. The leaderboard also reports an average partial-credit score separately.
explanation.zh: Pass rate 是拿到满分的 task run 占比。leaderboard 还会单独报告包含部分得分的平均 score。

summary.en: Agents' Last Exam evaluates agents on long-horizon, economically valuable professional workflows with verifiable outcomes.
summary.zh: Agents' Last Exam 评估 agent 能不能完成有明确验证结果、耗时较长且贴近真实工作的专业任务。

task_format.en: An agent works through a real digital-work task using the required tools and environment, then submits an outcome that can be checked.
task_format.zh: agent 会在指定工具和环境中完成真实的数字工作任务，最后提交一个可以被验证的结果。
